_comment: Recursion-termination guard, happy path (components/temporal-workflow.md, 'Resolved: Recursion Termination Guard'), under plan-and-execute. A clearly-Deliberate research task -> PlanWorkflow -> planning turn proposes ONE checkpoint. The checkpoint turn (<turn:1>:cp:1) spawns a subagent; that subagent delegates further to its OWN subagent WITH genuine delegated_scope/kept_work, so the guard allows it. Full chain, all real child workflows: <turn:1>:cp:1 -> :sub:1 -> :sub:1:sub:1, all completed.
